The augmented Torva platebody is a level 80 melee torso slot item created by using an augmentor on a Torva platebody.

sc: The augmented wand of the praesul is a level 92 Magic main hand weapon created by using an augmentor on a wand of the praesul.
Barrows amulets are obtained as a reward after finishing Missing, Presumed Death.
Thirty are obtained from the quest by speaking to the Statue of Death at the Empyrean Citadel.
A tradeable version of the amulet may also be obtained as a reward from the Barrows: Rise of the Six minigame.
The binding contract is made by killing a kal'gerion demon and binding them to a blank binding contract in the backpack, during which one binding contract is converted.
It can be made into 20 Kal'gerion Demon scrolls (Crit-i-Kal) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 1 experience.
The broken gnome glider is an item found in Odd's Sods, a shop run by the hill giant Odds within Hollow Hill.
It is not purchasable or obtainable in any way by players, as its stock is always set at 0.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 3 primal bars, requiring 3,300 progress to complete, granting a total of 4,200 Smithing experience.
The Brutal Off-hand Claw is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override available from Solomon's General Store.

sc: Bunny Ears are a head slot cosmetic override that is unlocked by completing 15 Egg Hunts during the Egg Hunt promotion from Treasure Hunter.
It can be found in the Gun locker within the hold of Bill Teach's ship, The Adventurous.

Chaotic brimstone is an Archaeological material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 29 Archaeology, at various dig sites around RuneScape.
It can be purchased as a reward from the Dungeoneering skill for 150,000 Dungeoneering tokens.

sc: The combat hood is a reward that can be purchased with tokens from the Fist of Guthix minigame.
Similar to all other armours obtained from the Fist of Guthix , it can be degraded for trading purposes by talking to Reggie in the cave and asking him to degrade the item.
Construction XP lamp is a reward for completing the Pieces of Hate quest rewarding 50,000 experience in the Construction skill when rubbed, destroying the lamp in the process.
The Cosmetic Equipment Bundle gift box is obtained by purchasing the Cosmetic Equipment Bundle for 250 RuneCoins during several mental health charity events (listed below).
The bundle can be purchased up to three times.
The cracked fishing urn (empty) is an item created by using a water rune on a cracked fishing urn (no rune).
A crawling hand is a very rare drop from crawling hands, zombie hands, and skeletal hands, requiring level 5 Slayer to kill.
There is a slim possibility to get two crawling hand drops from one monster if using the mask of broken fingers and it happens to be one of the ten double drop chances.

sc: The crystal hammer is a degradable hammer that is made by crystal singing with a crystal tool seed and 150 harmonic dust at the singing bowl in the Ithell District.
Demonic horns are an equippable head slot item that may be converted from the crown of the fallen, obtained by collecting a total of 2,500 rose petals.
It is sometimes received by completing an elite Treasure Trail.
The Dragon sq shield cannot be traded if it has an ornament kit attached, so one must detach it and then it can be traded as usual.

Elf-style boots (green).x: The green elf-style boots are part of the elven outfit item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.

sc: It is made by adding a emerald to an exquisite farming urn (no gem).
It can be obtained from small totem reward bundles, totem reward bundles, and grand totem reward bundles received from Mossteeth after participating in the Fenmoor Totems activity in Fenmoor.
The fragile divination urn (full) is an item made by filling a Fragile divination urn while training divination.
Froggi, the smithy's apprentice is a journal found by inspecting the Edgeville furnace after Ritual of the Mahjarrat.
It was made by loading an empty ghost buster 500 with a Blue destabiliser.
It was made by loading an empty ghost buster 500 with a red destabiliser.
The ghostly jester tights are part of the ghostly jester outfit which is made with 600 ghostweave.
A gissel potato is a unique food used in the Dungeoneering skill and can only be found in Daemonheim.
It is made by using a baked cave potato with a gissel mushroom.
It is found on a pedestal inside some caves under Eagles' Peak.
Green navy slacks is a cosmetic item that can be purchased from Honest Jimmy for 100 pieces of eight.
The guilded smile flag can be purchased from Honest Jimmy on Mos Le'Harmless for 200 Pieces of Eight.
The Helm of neitiznot (charged) could be made by using a combat scroll on a Helm of neitiznot (e).
Ice Spider is a companion pet that can be purchased for 875 Underworld Emblems from the Hero Store.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 8 of The Winter Trials with the Premier Pass.
The icicle crown is a reward for cutting down an Evil hawthorn tree, after completion of the Hawthorn part of the 2011 Easter event.
When you lose or destroy the crowns, they can be re-obtained from Diango with their previous charges still remaining.
A large XP lamp is a purchased reward from the Battle of Lumbridge, which grants the player 95% of the experience a large prismatic lamp would give.
Note: If you use a large XP lamp on Dungeoneering, you will not be awarded with the dungeoneering tokens.
A last will and testament was an item found on the fireplace in the Grim Reaper's house, and then relocated to the sofa in the 2007 Halloween event.

sc: Marrentill incense sticks are incense sticks that are made using the Firemaking skill that provide a stacking buff.
They are made by combining impious incense sticks with a clean marrentill, requiring level 9 Firemaking to create and use.

tx: Some Christmas presents could be exchanged for mince pies during the 2012 Festive Gifts Squeal of Fortune promotion.
sc: Mince pies were a possible reward from trading in a sapphire blue present or an emerald green present, giving five mince pies, or from trading in both the sapphire blue and emerald green presents, giving 15 mince pies.
A mince pie can also be obtained from a festive box that is earned by opening a clue casket on 23 to 25 December 2016.

Starbloom robes set + 5.x: A Starbloom robes set + 5 is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items from Starbloom robes + 5 with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: It was made by upgrading a reinforced slayer helmet for 400 Slayer points at any Slayer Master, although subsequent upgrades would only cost 40 Slayer points.
Supreme overloads (6) (unfinished) are partially-made supreme overload potions, made by Granny Rowan with a tier 3 Botanist's Workbench constructed in Fort Forinthry.

These unfinished overloads are made from all the same ingredients as normal (and the same level 98 Herblore requirement), but the ingredients must be noted, and the resulting unfinished potions are stackable.
The tanned unicorn hide is a quest item obtained by killing a white unicorn during the Fur 'n Seek quest, using a bag of salt on its hide, and tanning it.
It is made by using a hammer (tool belt will not work) on certain types of raw meat.
Tortured ashes are an item dropped by Edimmu inside Daemonheim.

Tumeken aura is a cosmetic override aura that could be obtained by participating in a successful encounter against Amascut, the Devourer at 2,000% enrage (in either enrage mode or the "Race to World's First" difficulty) during the initial release week of the boss (4 August 2025–10 August 2025).
It was awarded alongside the title.
The tundral stalker halberd is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 42 of The Knight Before Christmas.

It is created by drafting an unfinished masterwork magic draft at a drafting table until 9,000/30,000 (30%) progress for the item is achieved, at which point the draft turns into an unfinished masterwork magic item to be crafted at a tailor's dummy.
It can only be obtained and used within Daemonheim.
It can be created at level 36 Fletching by stringing an unstrung ukutu longbow with a bowstring.
It requires 85 Strength, Ranged, and Defence to wear, but not to obtain.
It may be received after winning in the TzHaar Fight Pit - an interface will appear from which one of the three hybrid armour bodies can be chosen.

sc: Veggie mush is a type of animal feed that can be obtained by removal from troughs at the player-owned farm, Manor Farm, provided that the trough had been filled solely with vegetables.
They can also be obtained from the Dream of Iaia skilling plots after the completion of the Extinction quest.
Volatile effigies are a reward from the Effigy Incubator Distraction and Diversion.
Vorago's arm is a boss trophy obtained from defeating Vorago.
A watermelon slice is a food for members only that can be obtained by using a knife on a watermelon.
Contrary to popular belief, no watermelon seeds can be obtained by eating watermelon.
A wooden bed flatpack can be made at a workbench (Wooden workbench or better) in the workshop of a player-owned house.
